title: Tenma Saki — Happy Birthday!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Everyone, check it out! My mom made me this really amazing lunch for my birthday!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, two boxes worth...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup! This one's for rice and sides.
And this one's for my dessert melon♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Nice. Pretty fancy birthday dessert you've got there.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, right? My mom crammed in a ton, so let's all have some together later!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Shiho, Saki & Honami
rows.Line: That was delicious!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you for the melon, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Please tell your mom thank you for us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I will♪ Oh, mind sticking around a bit before we all head back to class?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sure, I don't mind... Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: There's actually something I wanna give all of you... First up is Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you, Ms. Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You don't allow mistakes when it comes to music and you've given me lots of strict advice with regard to playing the synth.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because you've been willing to work so closely with me, I've gotten so much better and we're able to put on really amazing performances now!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: As such, I present you with this certificate of appreciation stamped with the Tenma seal♪ From Saki Tenma, who thinks you're an incredibly cool person and loves you for it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thanks, Saki...
I had no idea you prepared something like this for us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I wanted to show everyone just how much I appreciate them!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Next, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you, Ms. Hona!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: On top of always being available to talk about us as a band, you're nice enough to help with stuff about schoolwork and club activities.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You also watch over all of us with a warm gaze and make sure I don't push myself too hard.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: For being such a nice person, I present you with this certificate of appreciation stamped with the Tenma seal!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: From Saki Tenma, who hopes we get the chance to do another play-planetarium with you as that narrator!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh wow... Thank you so much, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She slyly threw in a favor at the end.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I've been wanting to do another one too, so I'll put something together to make sure I'm ready at a moment's notice.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You will?! You're the best, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Finally, Ichi! Thanks for waiting!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ahem...
Thank you, Ms. Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: For as long as I can remember, and even now, you've been a source of encouragement for me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You came to visit me so many times when I was in the hospital, and even said, “Everyone's waiting for you to come back.”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Even now, whenever I feel unsure or have a lot on my mind, you're there to support me and help me get through whatever's going on...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You've given me so much courage.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I didn't realize...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean it! You've always been there for me! So...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Even though I can't thank you enough, I present you with this certificate of appreciation stamped with the Tenma seal!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: From Saki Tenma, who hopes we'll be besties forever and ever!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki... Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
What do I do...?
I'm so happy... You've left me completely speechless...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, I really have to thank all of you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks for being such great childhood friends! I hope we get to be like this forever and ever and ever!

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Honami & Shiho
rows.Line: Us too!
Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Father & Mother
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa, Dad, Mom, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Alright, Saki.
Ready to blow out the candles?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup♪
*Blow*

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line:
*Sob*
She used to blow them out one by one, but now she can blow them out all at once...!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe. Oh, Dad.
Need a tissue?

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: Yes, thank you...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You know there weren't as many candles back then, right? I always tried to make the fun last as long as I could.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which part of the cake would you like, Saki? Naturally, the chocolate “Happy Birthday” plate will also be yours!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thanks, Tsukasa!
But gimme a second before you do that!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, ahem! Mom, Dad, Tsukasa... I'd like to present you all with certificates of appreciation!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Certificates of appreciation...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's right.
First, Mom!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thank you, Mother!
I'll forever be grateful to you for bringing me into the world and this family!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know I wasn't always healthy when I was little and made you worry a lot...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I'm happy and healthy now because you and everyone did everything you could to find the right doctors for me!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: As such, I present you with this certificate of appreciation stamped with the Tenma seal and this bouquet of flowers♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: From your daughter, Saki, who loves you so so sooo very much and knows you're the best mother in the world!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you...!
I love you very much too, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: Need a tissue?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Yes, please...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Dad, Tsukasa, I have certificates for you both too!

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line:
W-Wait, Saki!
I need a moment to prepare myself or you might give me a heart attack!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: S-Same here!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Well, if it's gonna cause that much harm, then I guess I'll skip you two.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line:
Wh-What?!
Saki, that also might give me a heart attack!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He's right! Hnng... See?! It's already starting! If you don't give us those certificates now, we might...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. Okay, I get it, so pull yourselves together! I wanna show just how much I appreciate the both of you!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Tenma!
You really surprised us when you gave us those adorable certificates of appreciation. I'll make sure to hang it up somewhere.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me too! Oh, Haruka and I picked out the lip gloss that was a part of your present. I really think it'll look good on you, so I hope you get a chance to use it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks for the wonderful certificate of appreciation, Saki! I couldn't be happier as an idol and your senior.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm looking for a present that also shows my appreciation for you, so stay tuned!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Saki.
And thank you for the certificate of appreciation. I wasn't expecting to also receive one.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I heard you gave one to Shii too, yes? She couldn't stop smiling after she got home. Hehe. I hope you two remain friends for a very long time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Saki!
Thank you for the certificate of appreciation. I know you've been very busy lately with your band and all.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Please let me know when you're doing another show! I promise to buy a ticket and be there to cheer you on!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Your show...! Honami invited me that other time, but I couldn't go because of my own show...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Please make sure to invite me to your next one, Saki! Oh, do you need a tambourine player? I can jingle-jangle for lots and lots if you ever need one♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki! Once more, happy birthday!!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Saki.
I'm so glad that you're able to just live your life now. Am I right in saying that you're just as relieved, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I was worried that you'd fall ill while at school, but I'm glad those concerns ended up being unfounded. Luckily, you have Ichika and the others to also look out for you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki. Your smiling face is what makes me, Mom and Dad the happiest, so please keep having fun and enjoying each day as much as you can.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Honami & Shiho
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We were planning on throwing you a surprise party with Miku and the others, but you managed to get the jump on us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Your handmade certificates of appreciation were so lovely. I mean, look at the pegasuses she drew for the borders. Their faces all look a little different.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Mine have this sharp and serious look while Honami's are grinning and Ichika's are singing. We can tell you put a lot of effort into these.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki. We all feel the same way about wanting to be together forever.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So let's keep doing our best and keep moving forward, together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you all for listening to our songs in SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because of your support, I always feel this warmth well up inside me whenever we do shows here.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You guys are the reason why we're able to do everything we can to put on good performances!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: As such, I present you all with this certificate of appreciation stamped with the Tenma seal! May 9th, from Saki Tenma, who couldn't be happier that all of you are here to celebrate with me!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Feel free to stop by whenever to listen to us play, okay? We'll be waiting!
